$description: Token proposals for Tooltip (carbon-labs v12): the hero tokens IconButton's primary kind reads. Moves to packages/themes at graduation. Colour values are OKLCH: `carbon.themes` holds the per-theme value and `com.ibm.harness.fallback` the pinned sRGB hex for non-P3 displays. With no brand set the hero tokens are the Carbon tokens they replace, value for value.

fill.$description: The hero fill: the brand colour for a filled selector. With no brand set it is Carbon's button-primary, IBM blue.

fill-hover.$description: The hero fill on hover. With no brand set it is Carbon's button-primary-hover.

on-fill.$description: The ink on a hero fill. With no brand set it is Carbon's icon-on-color, white.
